# Welcome

## Today
1. Setup: GitHub, Copilot, Codespaces, Claude Code
2. Git workflow — we all share one repo
3. Agents: `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, shortcuts
4. Group project: did Latino voters pivot to Trump?

## The repository
<https://github.com/crweber9874/UNM_Workshop>

```
data/        wss_2020_2024.csv   joined 2020 + 2024 survey
```

# 1. Setup

## Accounts & tools
- GitHub account → [education.github.com](https://education.github.com) for free Copilot
- Git + `gh auth login`
- Copilot in VS Code or RStudio
- Claude Code: `npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`, then `claude`

## Can't install? Codespace
**Code → Codespaces → Create codespace on main**

R, tidyverse, RStudio (port 8787), Quarto, Copilot, Claude Code — in the browser.

Stop it when done (60 free core-hours/month).

# 2. Git

## The model
```
Working dir → Staging → Local repo → GitHub
   (edit)      (add)     (commit)     (push)
                              ←  (pull)
```

## Get the repo
```bash
git clone https://github.com/crweber9874/UNM_Workshop.git
cd UNM_Workshop
```

## Everyday loop
```bash
git pull                       # first, always
git status
git add R/01_recode.R
git commit -m "Add generation recode"
git push
```

## Sharing one repo safely
```bash
git pull
git switch -c yourname-topic
# edit → add → commit
git push -u origin yourname-topic
gh pr create --fill
```
Merge on GitHub → everyone `git switch main && git pull`

## Conflicts
```
<<<<<<< HEAD
yours
=======
theirs
>>>>>>> main
```
Edit, remove markers, `add`, `commit`. Agents can help — **read the diff**.

# 3. Agents

## How an agent sees a repo
- Loads **instruction files** at start: `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
- Reads what you `@mention` or what it searches
- Runs commands — with permission

## Our AGENTS.md
```markdown
## Rules
- R + tidyverse, native pipe |>
- New recodes go in R/01_recode.R
- Always report n_obs and n_miss
- Use survey weights; say when you don't
- Don't push to main without approval
```
`CLAUDE.md` = `@AGENTS.md` → one source of truth. Start one with `/init`.

## Claude Code shortcuts
| | |
|---|---|
| `/init` `/memory` | create / edit instructions |
| `/agents` | build subagents |
| `/clear` `/compact` | manage context (and cost) |
| `/model` `/cost` | choose model, track spend |
| `/review` `/resume` | PR review, past sessions |
| `@file` `!cmd` | add file, run shell |
| `Shift+Tab` `Esc Esc` | plan mode, rewind |

## Copilot shortcuts
`Tab` accept · `Ctrl/Cmd+I` inline chat · `/explain /fix /tests` · `@workspace` · agent mode

# 4. Project

## Did Latino voters pivot to Trump?
Western States Survey 2020 & 2024 (AZ, CO, NV, NM, UT)

| Weighted Trump share | Non-Latino | Latino |
|---|---|---|
| 2020 | .50 | .40 |
| 2024 | .51 | .42 |

n_obs = 6,495; n_miss = 1,105. Small shift. Why the gap with exit polls?

## Teams
- **Recode**: generations, income, partisan strength
- **Analysis**: `brms` logit, authoritarianism × Latino × year
- **Shiny**: state panels, downloads
- **Skeptics**: sample, weights, intended vs. reported vote

Branch → commit → PR.

## Verify the machine
- Check coding against the codebook
- Check N and missingness
- Rerun it yourself
